cards.title: Rényi Coherent Information Is Monotone in Rényi Index for Stabilizer Codes Under Pauli Noise
cards.why_it_matters: If you work on quantum error correction or mixed-state phases, this resolves a standing ambiguity about whether Rényi coherent information is a well-ordered proxy for decodability transitions.
cards.summary: For stabilizer codes under independent Bernoulli Pauli noise, the Rényi-n coherent information is proven nondecreasing in n. A general combinatorial theorem covers classical linear codes and detector error models too. The paper also gives Rényi-n coherent information an operational meaning via postselection on n-1 auxiliary blocks, and shows saturation equals asymptotically perfect recovery of the postselected channel.

cards.title: Complete Single-Letter Formula for Asymptotic State Conversion in Quantum Resource Theory of Asymmetry
cards.why_it_matters: This resolves a long-open problem in quantum resource theory with implications for quantum clock precision and asymmetry distillation that could inform quantum ML and sensing work.
cards.summary: For finite-dimensional systems under compact Lie group symmetries in the i.i.d. asymptotic regime, the paper derives a single-letter formula for optimal state conversion rates with vanishing trace-distance error. The rate is governed by a one-parameter family of quantum Fisher information matrices interpolating between symmetric and right-logarithmic-derivative QFIs. Even for U(1) symmetry, no finite subfamily suffices in general, revealing irreversibility and an activation mechanism for quantum clocks.
